abstract: This article studies price discrimination by a seller who uses data on observables that buyers can control (or manipulate) at a cost. If the seller's discriminatory prices are offered covertly, equilibrium market segmentation is always coarse, resulting in limited price discrimination. In contrast, if prices must be transparently posted, every buyer pays a personalized price in equilibrium, though this does not always reduce buyer or social welfare. The analysis sheds new light on calls for transparency in how sellers utilize consumer data to customize prices and highlights potential issues with assessing welfare using (only) observed prices, pricing conduct, and market coverage.
abstract_zh: 本文研究卖方利用买方可以控制（或操纵）的可观测数据进行价格歧视的行为。若卖方的歧视性定价以隐蔽方式提供，均衡市场分割始终较为粗糙，导致有限的价格歧视。相反，若价格必须透明公示，则均衡状态下每位买方均需支付个性化价格，但这并不总能降低买方福利或社会福利。该分析为要求卖方透明化利用消费者数据定制价格的呼声提供了新视角，并揭示了仅依据观测价格、定价行为及市场覆盖率评估福利时可能存在的问题。
title: Price Discrimination With Manipulable Observables
title_zh: 可操纵观测值下的价格歧视

abstract: The energy transition from coal to gas is reshaping the power sector to rely more on gas generation, which is cleaner but has more variable input costs. Using counterfactual analysis, I study the competitive effects of this transition, by considering several transition paths that differ in the types of firms involved in retiring coal plants and investing in gas plants. I show that the variable nature of the marginal cost of gas generation creates an environment in which market power could increase after the transition. However, the transition's impact on competition depends on the characteristics of the firms investing in new gas generation; the adverse impact is mitigated under a well‐planned transition that leads to a more competitive industry structure.
abstract_zh: 从煤炭向天然气的能源转型正重塑电力行业，使其更加依赖天然气发电——这种发电方式更清洁，但投入成本波动性更大。通过反事实分析，本文研究了这一转型的竞争效应，考虑了若干种不同的转型路径，这些路径在参与退役燃煤电厂和投资天然气电厂的企业类型上存在差异。研究表明，天然气发电边际成本的波动性特征创造了一种环境，使得转型后市场势力可能增强。然而，转型对竞争的影响取决于投资新建天然气发电企业的特征；在精心规划的转型路径下，这种不利影响会得到缓解，从而形成更具竞争性的行业结构。
title: Cleaner but Volatile Energy? The Effect of Coal Plant Retirement on Market Competition in the Wholesale Electricity Market
title_zh: 更清洁但更不稳定的能源？煤电厂退役对电力批发市场竞争的影响

abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction - adding a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast - can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. Using the U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters for major macroeconomic indices across various subsamples (including pre/post-2000, GFC, and COVID), we find that a parsimonious correction of the mean forecast with a coefficient around 0.5 is a robust starting point and often yields material improvements in forecast accuracy. For optimal-weight forecasts, the correction substantially mitigates the forecast combination puzzle by turning poorly performing out-of-sample optimal-weight combinations into competitive forecasts.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种修正的组合预测方法，适用于原始组合预测误差存在序列相关性的情形。受Bates和Granger（1969）经典案例的启发，我们证明组合预测误差可能呈现强自相关性，而一个简单的修正——将上一期组合误差的一部分加入下一期组合预测——能够显著提升预测精度，其改进幅度往往超过组合本身带来的原始收益。我们在Gibbs和Vasnev（2024）的条件风险框架内对该方法进行了形式化处理，在该框架中，组合误差可分解为可预测成分（在预测起点可测）和创新项。随后，我们将该修正与时间序列依赖条件下通过广义最小二乘法对组合权重的高效估计联系起来，从而实现对权重与误差协方差结构的联合估计。基于美国专业预测者调查中主要宏观经济指标在不同子样本（包括2000年前后、全球金融危机及新冠疫情期间）的数据，我们发现，对均值预测采用系数约为0.5的简约修正是一个稳健的起点，且通常能带来预测精度的实质性提升。对于最优权重预测而言，该修正通过将表现不佳的样本外最优权重组合转化为具有竞争力的预测，显著缓解了预测组合难题。

abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，其存款余额显著减少，资金被重新配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。
title: Household Behavior Below the Zero Lower Bound
title_zh: 零下限以下的家庭行为

abstract: We develop a state-space framework that jointly estimates central bank credibility as a scalar latent variable and the associated time-varying monetary policy reaction function. The Kalman filter extracts an unobservable credibility index from observed inflation expectations, while Recursive Least Squares continuously updates the reaction function coefficients using the Kalman innovations sequence, ensuring that parameter estimation operates on long-run trend components rather than transitory fluctuations. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish consistency of the credibility estimator and show that the reaction function coefficients attain the Cramer-Rao bound when the innovation variance is constant; a GLS variant achieves efficiency in the heteroskedastic case. Applying the framework to Banco de Mexico over 2002-2024, we identify four distinct credibility regimes: a consolidation phase following the adoption of inflation targeting (2002-2008), a transitory shock during the global financial crisis (2008-2009), a sustained high-credibility equilibrium (2010-2020), and a stress episode associated with post-pandemic inflation (2021-2023) followed by partial recovery. The time-varying reaction coefficients reveal that Banco de Mexico's responsiveness to the inflation gap is itself a function of its credibility state: stronger anchoring permits a more measured policy response, while credibility deterioration triggers sharper, front-loaded adjustments. These findings have direct implications for the optimal design of monetary policy communication in emerging markets and for the broader debate on whether central bank credibility generates real persistent effects beyond its role in expectation coordination.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个状态空间框架，将央行可信度作为标量潜变量与随时间变化的货币政策反应函数进行联合估计。卡尔曼滤波从观测到的通胀预期中提取不可观测的可信度指数，而递推最小二乘法则利用卡尔曼创新序列持续更新反应函数系数，确保参数估计基于长期趋势成分而非暂时性波动。在标准正则性条件下，我们证明了可信度估计量的一致性，并表明当创新方差恒定时，反应函数系数达到克拉美-罗下界；在异方差情形下，广义最小二乘变体可实现有效性。将该框架应用于2002-2024年期间的墨西哥银行，我们识别出四个不同的可信度区间：通胀目标制实施后的巩固阶段（2002-2008年）、全球金融危机期间的暂时冲击（2008-2009年）、持续的高可信度均衡（2010-2020年）、以及疫情后通胀相关的压力时期（2021-2023年）及随后的部分恢复。时变反应系数揭示，墨西哥银行对通胀缺口的反应程度本身是其可信度状态的函数：更强的锚定效应允许更审慎的政策回应，而可信度恶化则会触发更剧烈的前置调整。这些发现对新兴市场货币政策沟通的最优设计，以及关于央行可信度是否在预期协调作用之外产生真实持久效应的广泛讨论，具有直接启示意义。
title: Dynamic central bank credibility: a Kalman Filter–Recursive Least Squares approach for emerging markets
title_zh: 动态中央银行可信度：新兴市场的卡尔曼滤波–递归最小二乘法

abstract: We construct a Broad Market Factor (BMF), which is a proxy for the value-weighted equity return on all firms in the US economy (public and private). The BMF differs from the standard Value-weighted Market Factor (VMF), which reflects the value-weighted equity return on public firms. We define the difference between the VMF and the BMF to be the Idiosyncratic Financial Factor (IFF). The IFF carries no risk premium and is uncorrelated with all macroeconomic proxies for investor marginal utility we consider. CAPM betas and, consequently, discount rates are underestimated when measured with respect to the VMF compared to the BMF for most portfolios. Size factors become redundant and the size anomaly is resolved when the VMF is replaced by the BMF in standard factor models. The intertemporal risk-return relation is substantially stronger when one replaces the VMF with the BMF. The unifying explanation for these results is that the IFF adds unpriced risk to the VMF, distorting both cross-sectional and time-series estimates of exposure to priced market risk.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个广义市场因子（BMF），用以代表美国经济中所有企业（包括上市公司与非上市公司）的价值加权股权回报。BMF与标准价值加权市场因子（VMF）存在差异，后者仅反映上市公司的价值加权股权回报。我们将VMF与BMF之间的差值定义为特质金融因子（IFF）。该IFF不包含风险溢价，且与我们考虑的所有投资者边际效用宏观经济代理变量均不相关。对于大多数投资组合而言，相较于基于BMF的测算，基于VMF的CAPM贝塔值及由此得出的贴现率均被低估。当标准因子模型中的VMF被BMF替代时，规模因子变得冗余，规模异象得以消除。用BMF替代VMF后，跨期风险-收益关系显著增强。这些结果的统一解释是：IFF为VMF增加了未定价风险，从而扭曲了横截面与时间序列上对定价市场风险暴露程度的估计。
title: A Tale of Two Market Returns: The Broad Market Factor and The Idiosyncratic Financial Factor
title_zh: 两种市场收益的故事：广泛市场因子与特质金融因子

abstract: Accurate stock price forecasting has consistently remained a pivotal yet challenging FinTech task that underpins quantitative trading and investment decision making. Recent efforts have been dedicated to modeling various complex relationships among stocks in the stock market toward more reliable stock price forecasting.These methods depend heavily on strong static prior assumptions by modeling either temporal dependencies within individual stocks or spatial dependencies across different stocks based on predefined structures, while the complex market dynamics that drive stock price movements remain unexplored. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel game-theoretic modeling method that captures heterogeneous investor interactions for stock price forecasting. The core idea is to embed game-theoretic mechanisms into the heterogeneous graph structure to finely model the dynamic strategic interactions among heterogeneous investors with respect to target stocks. Additionally, temporal positional encoding is adopted to reflect the differentiated influences of each game event at different time steps within the time window on future stock price movements. Leveraging heterogeneous graph networks, we proxy the intricate dynamics of the stock market through investor games and enable real-time information propagation and node updates among all nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on two real-world benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method effectively outperforms state-of-the-art stock price forecasting methods.
abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。其核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法有效超越了现有最优的股价预测方法。
title: Game-Theoretic Modeling of Heterogeneous Investor Interactions for Stock Price Forecasting
title_zh: 异质投资者互动的博弈论建模及其在股价预测中的应用

abstract: The effects of the bank levy in Poland on the broadly defined credit market (including on loan rates and volumes) appear to be well documented, with the use of the standard difference-in-differences (DID) method. However, as, for example, Borusyak et al. (2024) note, in a setting with staggered treatment (as in the case of the bank levy in Poland), and different effects of the treatment in time and between cross-sections, the method might provide biased estimates. None of the studies to date used the heterogenous DID method that addresses this drawback. In this research note I use the heterogenous DID method to estimate the consequences of the bank levy. I also discuss other methodological choices. Among other things, I find that the bank levy has lowered deposit rates, raised rates on loans for house purchases, and changed the composition and the level of bank assets. However, I find no longer-term crowding out of credit by government bond securities (while the latter did increase, the former did not increase) or effects on bank profitability. The use of a more advised method did not lead to results in stark contrast with the earlier literature applying methods for causal inference.
abstract_zh: 波兰银行税对广义信贷市场（包括贷款利率和规模）的影响已有充分文献记载，且普遍采用标准双重差分法（DID）进行分析。然而，正如Borusyak等人（2024）所指出的，在交错处理情境下（如波兰银行税案例），若处理效应在时间维度与截面维度存在异质性，该方法可能产生有偏估计。现有研究均未采用能解决此缺陷的异质性双重差分法。本研究采用异质性双重差分法评估银行税的经济后果，并探讨其他方法论选择。研究发现：银行税降低了存款利率，提高了购房贷款利率，并改变了银行资产的构成与规模。但未发现政府债券对信贷存在长期挤出效应（尽管债券规模上升，信贷规模并未下降），也未发现银行税对盈利能力产生显著影响。采用更优方法所得结论与早期运用因果推断方法的研究并无显著差异。
title: Yet another estimate of the consequences of the bank levy for the credit market in Poland
title_zh: 银行税对波兰信贷市场影响的又一估计

abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused major disruptions in international trade and has raised concerns about adverse effects on international supply chains. Using a unique establishment survey matched with administrative data from Germany, we provide novel evidence on how establishments have adjusted their supply chains in response to pandemic-induced disruptions. We find that establishments that experienced difficulties in obtaining intermediate inputs as a result of the pandemic are significantly more likely to change their network of suppliers than establishments without such problems, especially if disruptions affected imports from abroad. Establishments experiencing supply chain difficulties are more likely to replace a distant with a closer supplier. However, these adjustments in response to the pandemic appear to be temporary.
abstract_zh: COVID-19疫情对国际贸易造成了重大冲击，并引发了对国际供应链负面影响的担忧。通过将德国独特的机构调查数据与行政数据相匹配，我们提供了关于机构如何应对疫情引发的供应链中断而进行调整的新证据。研究发现，因疫情而面临中间投入品获取困难的机构，其调整供应商网络的可能性显著高于未遭遇此类问题的机构，尤其是当供应链中断影响到海外进口时。遭遇供应链困难的机构更倾向于用距离更近的供应商替代距离较远的供应商。然而，这些针对疫情的调整似乎是暂时性的。

abstract: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $\lambda^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\bar{\lambda}$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |\Delta_\ell/\Delta_w|$, and discount factor $\beta$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p, \beta)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\bar{\lambda}$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.
abstract_zh: 本文研究含吸收灾难状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制问题。尽管奖励函数为线性且决策者不存在效用曲率、概率权重或框架依赖，标准贝尔曼最优性仍产生三种类似前景理论的特征：S形价值函数轮廓（近灾难区域凸性、远场区域凹性）、内生的损失敏感系数$\lambda^*(S) > 1$，以及反射效应策略反转。在495种配置中，最优策略在正漂移（增长）模式下于近灾难区域选择保守策略（尽管风险行为具有更高的即时期望价值），而在负漂移（衰退）模式下于近灾难区域选择风险策略（尽管保守行为具有更低的即时期望损失）。我们推导出渐近损失厌恶平台$\bar{\lambda}$的闭式表达式，该表达式仅取决于获胜概率$p$、收益不对称性$r = |\Delta_\ell/\Delta_w|$和贴现因子$\beta$，且与数值解的拟合优度达$R^2 = 0.999$。该机制无需非对称收益。在三种不对称水平下对$(p, \beta)$进行全参数扫描时，$\bar{\lambda}$大于1的部分中，不对称性贡献的中位数在$r = 1.25$时为4.6%，在$r = 2$时升至13.9%，且所有测试单元中边界贡献均超过不对称性贡献。该现象在表格型Q学习（无模型智能体在增长模式下与$V^*$的相关性为0.98，在衰退模式下为1.00）以及随机转移过程中（高斯噪声、重尾Student-$t_3$噪声、非对称偏态正态噪声，噪声幅度最高达步长的50%）均持续存在，其中渐近平台在安全通道噪声下与闭式预测的偏差在0.41%以内，在风险通道或双通道噪声下偏差在9.6%以内。这些结果表明，吸收失败状态是产生最优控制下类似前景理论行为的充分结构性机制。
title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
title_zh: 具有灾难状态的MDP中来自贝尔曼最优性的前景理论行为

abstract: We develop an information-based intervention against sexual harassment and test it in a randomized control trial across small groups of military recruits in the boot camp of the Norwegian military. The intervention seeks to bridge two knowledge gaps with implications for sexual harassment prevalence. We tell some recruits about their peers' beliefs that "telling sexualized jokes can be labeled sexual harassment" and about women soldiers' equal performance on military skill tests. This treatment gives lasting improvements in knowledge about what sexual harassment is and about women's job performance. The impact on sexual harassment prevalence is directionally negative but statistically insignificant. We discuss measurement error and use survey responses about a harassment scenario to argue that the intervention likely affected behavior. Our study provides the first field experiment to evaluate whether a prevention method against sexual harassment reduces prevalence in a work setting. We use insights from our research process to identify methodological pitfalls and provide guidance for future field experiments in this area.
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种基于信息的性骚扰干预措施，并在挪威军队新兵训练营的小规模新兵群体中通过随机对照试验进行了测试。该干预措施旨在弥合两个与性骚扰发生率相关的认知差距。我们向部分新兵告知其同伴认为“讲黄色笑话可被视为性骚扰”的观点，以及女兵在军事技能测试中表现同样出色的信息。这一干预措施显著提升了受试者对性骚扰定义及女性工作表现的认知，且效果具有持续性。干预对性骚扰发生率的影响呈负向趋势，但未达到统计显著性。我们讨论了测量误差问题，并利用关于骚扰情境的问卷调查结果论证该干预措施可能影响了实际行为。本研究提供了首个通过实地实验评估工作场所性骚扰预防措施有效性的证据。我们基于研究过程中的洞察识别了方法论陷阱，并为该领域未来的实地实验提供了指导建议。
title: Targeting Attitudes to Combat Sexual Harassment: A Randomized Intervention in the Norwegian Military
title_zh: 针对态度以打击性骚扰：挪威军队中的随机干预实验

abstract: Data centers now account for 4.4% of United States electricity demand, yet the grid-level effectiveness of the renewable energy certificates (RECs) and power purchase agreements (PPAs) hyperscalers use to claim carbon neutrality remains unclear. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a data center operator chooses among RECs, PPAs, and behind-the-meter colocation while generators make entry decisions under endogenous financing costs. The model identifies a timing wedge -- the mismatch between consumption and credited renewable generation -- as a central mechanism through which AI demand degrades reliability, raises prices, and increases emissions even when RECs cover 100% of annual consumption. Colocation with storage addresses this wedge directly and induces the greatest renewable entry by eliminating generator revenue risk. We test these predictions by exploiting the staggered release of large language models as a natural experiment, using difference-in-differences on a novel dataset linking AI activity to local grid outcomes. AI demand significantly increases fossil generation, wholesale prices (up to 25% in treated PJM zones), and outage frequency (0.5--1 additional outages per year) near data centers, with impacts scaling in model size. Data centers with on-site generation exhibit a sign reversal in power-quality effects, consistent with the model's prediction that behind-the-meter capacity absorbs demand spikes. Counterfactual analyses show that edge inference, spatial reallocation, and colocated storage each substantially mitigate grid impacts, while REC-only strategies do not. Together, our results demonstrate that the externalities of AI to the grid are tightly coupled to procurement design and the spatial organization of data center infrastructure.
abstract_zh: 数据中心目前占美国电力需求的4.4%，然而，超大规模企业用于宣称碳中和的可再生能源证书（RECs）和购电协议（PPAs）在电网层面的有效性仍不明确。我们构建了一个博弈论模型，其中数据中心运营商在RECs、PPAs和表后共置方案之间进行选择，而发电商则在内生融资成本下做出进入决策。该模型识别出一个时间错配——即电力消费与可归因的可再生能源发电之间的时间差——作为核心机制，通过这一机制，即使RECs覆盖100%的年度消费，人工智能需求仍会降低电网可靠性、推高电价并增加碳排放。与储能设施共置直接解决了这一时间错配问题，并通过消除发电商的收入风险，最大程度地促进了可再生能源的进入。我们利用大语言模型的分阶段发布作为自然实验，通过双重差分法对连接人工智能活动与地方电网结果的新数据集进行检验，以验证这些预测。人工智能需求显著增加了数据中心附近化石燃料发电量、批发电价（在受影响的PJM区域最高上涨25%）以及停电频率（每年额外增加0.5至1次停电），且影响程度随模型规模扩大而增强。配备自备发电设施的数据中心在电能质量效应上表现出符号反转，这与模型预测一致，即表后容量能够吸收需求尖峰。反事实分析表明，边缘推理、空间重新布局以及共置储能均能显著缓解电网影响，而仅依赖RECs的策略则无法实现。综合来看，我们的研究结果表明，人工智能对电网的外部性与采购设计及数据中心基础设施的空间组织紧密相关。
title: Certificates without Electrons? Theory and Evidence on Impacts from AI-Driven Power Demand
title_zh: 没有电子的证书？人工智能驱动电力需求影响的理论与证据

abstract: This paper studies formal employment dynamics using linked employer-employee data from eight countries spanning a wide income range from Kenya to Chile. First, we show that formality rates increase with development, both between and within countries, because more workers enter the formal sector, not because they spend more time in formal jobs. Second, formal labor market fluidity increases with development, as workers hold more formal jobs, spend less time in each job, and less time between jobs. Third, greater fluidity is associated with higher life-cycle wage growth, which is largely accounted for by within- rather than between-firm wage gains.
abstract_zh: 本文利用涵盖从肯尼亚到智利等八个收入水平差异显著国家的关联雇主-雇员数据，研究正规就业的动态变化。首先，我们发现正规就业率随经济发展而上升，这一趋势既体现在国家间也体现在国家内部，其原因是更多劳动者进入正规部门，而非他们在正规岗位上的工作时间延长。其次，正规劳动力市场的流动性随经济发展而增强，表现为劳动者从事更多正规工作、每份工作持续时间缩短、以及工作转换间隔时间减少。第三，更高的流动性伴随着更显著的职业生涯工资增长，这主要归因于企业内部而非企业间的工资提升。
title: Formal Labor Market Dynamics and Development
title_zh: 正规劳动力市场动态与发展

abstract: How do international investors adjust portfolios in response to biodiversity risk? Using monthly data on investment fund portfolios, we show that the 2021 Kunming Declaration led fund managers to reallocate portfolios from high-biodiversity risk countries to less risky ones, while ultimate fund investors remained unresponsive. Fund managers reduced exposures to extremely high biodiversity risk without seizing low biodiversity risk as an opportunity for profit, characterizing biodiversity as downside risk factor. Investment funds drive cross-country spillovers as the reallocation triggers significant capital flows beneï¬ ting countries in the same geographic region, but outside of a fund's hitherto established portfolio. Using a novel measure of legal action to protect nature, we demonstrate that countries adopting more legal acts are partially shielded from funds reducing their exposure to high-biodiversity risk countries.
abstract_zh: 国际投资者如何根据生物多样性风险调整投资组合？利用投资组合的月度数据，我们发现2021年《昆明宣言》促使基金经理将投资组合从高生物多样性风险国家重新配置至低风险国家，而最终基金投资者对此未作出反应。基金经理减少了极端高生物多样性风险的敞口，但并未将低生物多样性风险视为获利机会，从而将生物多样性定性为下行风险因素。投资基金的重新配置引发了显著的跨境资本流动，使同一地理区域但此前未被基金纳入投资组合的国家受益，从而推动了跨国溢出效应。通过采用衡量自然保护法律行动的新指标，我们证明，采取更多法律行动的国家能够部分抵御基金减少高生物多样性风险国家敞口的影响。
title: Financing Nature:Investment Funds and Biodiversity Risks
title_zh: 自然融资：投资基金与生物多样性风险

abstract: States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.
abstract_zh: 国家是主要的国际融资方，但其作用尚未得到充分理解。我们利用涵盖1790年以来134个政府和70个多边机构120万笔官方贷款与赠款的新数据库，研究两个世纪以来国家驱动的跨境贷款。我们揭示了国际信贷的双重、国家依存结构。在正常时期，私人债权人主导跨境贷款。而在战争和金融危机等不利世界状态下，官方债权人会介入，有时规模巨大。这些官方资金流动由大国驱动，享有高额补贴，且在国际宏观经济学的经典模型中基本缺失。

abstract: We show that the optimal monetary policy and exchange rate framework depend critically on the economy’s commodity exposure. We develop a flexible but tractable model economy with commodity exports and imports, in which international financial conditions may vary with the commodity cycle, and we compute the welfare-optimal policy in the presence of price and wage rigidities. Stabilizing domestic prices is welfare-optimal for commodity exporters, in line with standard open-economy policy prescriptions. But for economies that use commodities as inputs in production, optimal policy largely ‘looks through’ the direct and indirect effects of commodity shocks on domestic prices; this contrasts with some earlier findings and policy practice (which only ‘looks through’ the direct effect). Exchange-rate pegs increase welfare for commodity importers because they stabilize wages and employment, though it is not a robustly optimal policy. In emerging and developing economies, where financial conditions are more tied to the commodity cycle, trade-offs are starker and implementing the optimal policy may be challenging, since it requires enough credibility to keep inflation expectations anchored amidst greater volatility in some nominal variables.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，最优货币政策与汇率框架的关键取决于经济体的商品敞口程度。我们构建了一个兼具灵活性与可操作性的模型经济体，该模型包含商品进出口部门，且国际金融条件可能随商品周期变化，并在存在价格与工资粘性的条件下计算了福利最优政策。对于商品出口国而言，稳定国内价格是福利最优选择，这与标准开放经济政策建议一致。但对于将商品作为生产投入的经济体，最优政策在很大程度上会"忽略"商品冲击对国内价格的直接与间接影响——这与部分早期研究发现及政策实践（仅"忽略"直接影响）形成对比。对商品进口国而言，钉住汇率制度能提升福利水平，因其可稳定工资与就业，但这并非稳健的最优政策。在新兴市场与发展中经济体，金融条件与商品周期的关联更为紧密，政策权衡更为严峻，实施最优政策可能面临挑战——这要求政策具备足够公信力，以便在部分名义变量波动加剧时仍能锚定通胀预期。

abstract: Over the past century, the United States has provided dollar liquidity abroad through both the US Treasury and the Federal Reserve, but the appropriate mode of liquidity injection depends on the economic, financial, and geopolitical contexts. The Treasury is the more appropriate lending conduit when geopolitical concerns dominate, while Fed dollar provision should primarily be targeted toward global stability objectives and be more insulated from short-term foreign policy motives. Up to now, political abuses of these foreign lending channels have been constrained to some degree by laws, norms, and intergovernmental understandings, but adherence can no longer be assumed, so more formal guardrails are needed.
abstract_zh: 过去一个世纪以来，美国通过财政部和美联储向海外提供美元流动性，但适当的流动性注入模式取决于经济、金融和地缘政治背景。当地缘政治关切占主导地位时，财政部是更合适的贷款渠道，而美联储的美元供给应主要针对全球稳定目标，并更少受短期外交政策动机的影响。迄今为止，法律、规范和政府间谅解在一定程度上约束了这些对外贷款渠道的政治滥用，但已无法假定各方会继续遵守，因此需要更正式的防护措施。
title: Taking geopolitically motivated US swap lines too far would harm the dollar and Fed independence
title_zh: 将地缘政治驱动的美国互换额度推得太远将损害美元和美联储独立性

abstract: This paper studies how financial conditions affect research and development (R&D) by firms specialized in green innovation. Using U.S. patent data matched with Compustat, we identify “green innovators” as firms with a high cumulative share of green patents. Although they account for a small share of total green patenting, these firms occupy central positions in the green-innovation ecosystem. Estimating firm-level impulse responses to exogenous changes in broad financial conditions, we find that tightening has a disproportionately large and persistent negative effect on the R&D of specialized green innovators. In contrast, R&D by diversified innovators and non-innovators responds only weakly. Green innovators are younger, smaller, and more dependent on external finance, suggesting that financial tightening introduces a systematic bias against upstream green technological development.
abstract_zh: 本文研究金融状况如何影响专注于绿色创新的企业的研发活动。通过将美国专利数据与Compustat数据库匹配，我们将“绿色创新者”定义为绿色专利累计占比高的企业。尽管这些企业在绿色专利总量中占比很小，但它们处于绿色创新生态系统的核心位置。通过估计企业对外生广义金融状况变化的脉冲响应，我们发现金融紧缩对专业化绿色创新企业的研发产生了不成比例的大幅且持续的负面影响。相比之下，多元化创新者和非创新者的研发反应较弱。绿色创新者通常更年轻、规模更小且更依赖外部融资，这表明金融紧缩对上游绿色技术发展产生了系统性偏见。

abstract: We investigate the systemic risk contribution of 3, 500 Money Market Funds (MMFs) in normal periods and during asset price bubbles in the US from January 2004 to December 2022. Using state-of-the-art statistical techniques for bubble detection and granular fund-level data, we show that MMF characteristics significantly influence systemic risk. Large MMFs and government MMFs, which invest exclusively in US Treasury securities, are associated with reduced systemic risk, while prime MMFs contribute to higher systemic risk. MMFs denominated in US dollars but domiciled offshore exhibit no significant differences from their US-domiciled counterparts.
abstract_zh: 本文以2004年1月至2022年12月美国3,500只货币市场基金为样本，系统考察其在常态时期与资产价格泡沫期间的系统性风险贡献。运用前沿泡沫检测统计技术与基金层面微观数据，研究发现货币市场基金特征对系统性风险具有显著影响。大型货币市场基金及仅投资于美国国债的政府型货币市场基金与较低的系统性风险相关，而优质型货币市场基金则加剧系统性风险。以美元计价但注册于离岸市场的货币市场基金，其系统性风险水平与在岸基金无显著差异。
title: Asset price bubbles and systemic risk in money market funds
title_zh: 资产价格泡沫与货币市场基金的系统性风险

abstract: We study whether AI methods applied to large-scale portfolio holdings data can improve macroprudential financial regulation. We build a graph-based deep learning model tailored to security-level data on the holdings of financial intermediaries. The architecture incorporates economic priors and learns latent representations of both assets and investors from the network structure of portfolio positions. Applied to the universe of non-bank financial intermediaries, covering nearly $40 trillion in wealth, the model substantially outperforms existing approaches in out-of-sample forecasts of intermediary trading behavior, including in crisis episodes. The model has more than ten times the explanatory power for the cross-sectional variation in asset returns during stress events compared to traditional approaches, and it outperforms existing systemic risk metrics at the institution level. Its learned representations show that the holdings network encodes rich, economically interpretable information about fire- sale vulnerability. The architecture is fully inductive, producing informative estimates even when entire asset classes or investors are withheld from training. We embed our empirical approach into a macroprudential optimal policy framework to formalize why these objects matter for policy and welfare. We show that even in an equilibrium environment subject to the Lucas critique, the predictive information from the model improves welfare by sharpening the cross-sectional targeting of policy interventions, and we demonstrate a complementarity between prediction and structural knowledge.
abstract_zh: 本文研究人工智能方法应用于大规模投资组合持仓数据能否改善宏观审慎金融监管。我们构建了一个基于图的深度学习模型，专门针对金融中介机构持有的证券级数据。该架构融合了经济先验知识，通过投资组合持仓的网络结构学习资产与投资者的潜在表征。将该模型应用于覆盖近40万亿美元财富的非银行金融中介机构整体数据时，其在预测中介交易行为（包括危机时期）的样本外表现显著优于现有方法。在压力事件期间，该模型对资产收益截面变异的解释力是传统方法的十倍以上，且在机构层面优于现有系统性风险指标。模型习得的表征表明，持仓网络编码了关于火线抛售脆弱性的丰富且具有经济可解释性的信息。该架构具有完全归纳能力，即使将整个资产类别或投资者排除在训练集之外，仍能产生具有信息量的估计结果。我们将实证方法嵌入宏观审慎最优政策框架，以形式化说明这些变量对政策与福利的重要性。研究表明，即使在面临卢卡斯批判的均衡环境中，该模型的预测信息通过强化政策干预的截面精准度提升了社会福利，并揭示了预测能力与结构性知识之间的互补关系。
title: The Optimal Use of AI in Financial Regulation
title_zh: 人工智能在金融监管中的最优应用

abstract: Geoeconomic fragmentation—the phenomenon of international transactions being increasingly restricted to politically aligned partners-creates risks for individual countries but also opportunities that some hope to seize by becoming "connector" countries. We modify a standard trade model by introducing iceberg costs that increase with geopolitical distance between country pairs. The response of per capita consumption to a geopolitical shock is shown to depend on two related but distinct indices: vulnerability, which is a country's transaction-weighted geopolitical distance from its trade partners, and connectedness, which is a country's transaction-weighted standard deviation of geopolitical distance from trade partners. The latter captures a country's geopolitical diversification. We distinguish between this type of "horizontal" connectedness and the supply chain-related "vertical" connectedness discussed by previous authors, arguing that the horizontal measure is more relevant in a geoeconomically fragmenting world. We construct a comprehensive database to examine geoeconomic vulnerability and connectedness across multiple types of international transactions, documenting several stylized facts.
abstract_zh: 地缘经济碎片化——即国际交易日益局限于政治立场一致的伙伴之间的现象——既给各国带来风险，也带来机遇，一些国家希望通过成为"连接国"来抓住这些机遇。我们通过引入随国家间地缘政治距离增加而上升的冰山成本，对标准贸易模型进行了修正。研究表明，人均消费对地缘政治冲击的反应取决于两个相关但不同的指标：脆弱性，即一国与其贸易伙伴之间按交易量加权的地缘政治距离；以及连接度，即一国与其贸易伙伴之间按交易量加权的地缘政治距离标准差。后者反映了一国的地缘政治多元化程度。我们将这种"横向"连接度与先前学者讨论的供应链相关"纵向"连接度加以区分，认为在地缘经济碎片化加剧的世界中，横向指标更具相关性。我们构建了一个综合数据库，考察多种国际交易类型中的地缘经济脆弱性与连接度，并归纳出若干典型化事实。

abstract: This paper estimates Korea's long-run real neutral interest rate and quantifies the structural forces behind its decline since 1990. Using semiannual data for 12 advanced economies over 1990-2024, we estimate a cross-country panel state-space model that separates country-specific productivity and demographic trends from common global components. Korea's neutral rate falls from about 1.6% in 1990 to roughly 0.7% in 2024. The model attributes this decline mainly to slower trend productivity growth, the post-2014 reversal in the working-age population share, and spillovers from major advanced economies. Safe-asset market forces also contribute, but supply and demand effects partly offset each other. Counterfactual simulations suggest that removing global spillovers would raise the 2024 estimate by about 0.6 percentage points, while holding the working-age share at its 2014 level would raise it by about 0.5 percentage points. Conditional demographic scenarios imply continued downward pressure absent offsetting structural changes, highlighting implications for monetary policy space.
abstract_zh: 本文估算了韩国的长期实际中性利率，并量化了1990年以来其下降背后的结构性因素。利用1990-2024年间12个发达经济体的半年度数据，我们估计了一个跨国面板状态空间模型，该模型将国家特定的生产率和人口趋势与共同的全球成分分离开来。韩国的中性利率从1990年的约1.6%下降至2024年的约0.7%。模型将这一下降主要归因于趋势生产率增长放缓、2014年后劳动年龄人口占比的逆转以及主要发达经济体的溢出效应。安全资产市场力量也起到一定作用，但供给和需求效应部分相互抵消。反事实模拟表明，消除全球溢出效应将使2024年的估计值提高约0.6个百分点，而将劳动年龄人口占比维持在2014年水平则会使估计值提高约0.5个百分点。条件性人口情景表明，若无抵消性结构变化，下行压力将持续存在，这对货币政策空间具有重要启示。
title: Demographic Changes and Neutral Interest Rates: Evidence from theWorld's Fastest-Aging Economy

abstract: We analyze how social-planner insurers split cost-sharing between consumers and firms (e.g. patients and doctors, or drivers and car mechanics). With no contracting frictions, firm cost-sharing can replace consumer cost-sharing other than “visit copays.” Optimal firm contracts depend on the marginal rate of substitution between consumer and firm cost-sharing. For Medicare physician services, paying physicians more up front but less as spending increases reduces risk for both patients and providers; in our calibration, net benefits are twice those from eliminating Medigap externality. For prescription drugs, a dollar of physician paperwork costs is 45–110 times more impactful than a dollar of consumer cost-sharing.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了社会规划型保险公司如何在消费者与企业（例如患者与医生，或驾驶员与汽车修理工）之间分摊成本。在不存在契约摩擦的情况下，除"就诊共付额"外，企业成本分摊可替代消费者成本分摊。最优企业契约取决于消费者与企业成本分摊之间的边际替代率。以医疗保险医生服务为例，提高预付比例但降低随支出递增的支付比例，可同时降低患者与医疗服务提供者的风险；在我们的校准模型中，其净收益是消除医疗补充保险外部性收益的两倍。对于处方药而言，医生每增加一美元文书工作成本的影响，是消费者每增加一美元成本分摊的45至110倍。
title: Insurance with Multiple Actors

abstract: Many effects of pollution exposure on health and education outcomes of children have been identified, but little is known about education effects on preschool-aged children. We estimate the effect of particulate matter air pollution on preschool attendance using restricted administrative data from the state of Georgia. We use thermal inversions, weather phenomena that trap pollutants, as an instrumental variable for pollution. A one-unit increase in the county-week average ambient particulate pollution level decreases attendance by around 2 percentage points. Effects seem to be larger for racial minorities and for children with working parents.
abstract_zh: 已有研究证实污染暴露对儿童健康与教育成果的多重影响，但关于污染对学龄前儿童教育的影响仍知之甚少。本研究利用佐治亚州的受限行政数据，评估颗粒物空气污染对学前教育出勤率的影响。我们采用热逆温现象（一种滞留污染物的天气现象）作为污染的工具变量。结果显示，县级周均环境颗粒物污染水平每增加一个单位，出勤率下降约2个百分点。该效应在少数族裔儿童及父母双职工家庭中更为显著。

abstract: Previous studies have shown that banks avoid passing negative monetary policy rates through to depositors, implying losses in deposit taking that erode equity and eventually have a negative impact on the lending of capital constrained banks. This paper shows that unconstrained banks respond differently, increasing loan supply even more with a deposit zero lower bound (D-ZLB) than without it. As a result, rate cuts below zero can be more stimulative than in positive territory, provided enough banks are unconstrained. A calibrated dynamic model finds this effect substantial, increasing aggregate loan supply by about 9% despite equity erosion pressures.
abstract_zh: 以往研究表明，银行会避免将负利率货币政策传导至存款人，这导致存款业务亏损侵蚀资本，并最终对资本受限银行的贷款产生负面影响。本文发现，不受约束的银行对此反应不同：在存款零下限（D-ZLB）环境下，其贷款供给增幅甚至超过无此约束时的水平。因此，只要存在足够多的不受约束银行，负利率政策下的降息可能比正利率区间更具刺激效应。经校准的动态模型显示，尽管存在资本侵蚀压力，该效应仍使总贷款供给增加约9%。
title: Transmission of Negative Interest Rates: Reversal or Amplification?
title_zh: 负利率的传导：逆转还是放大？

abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
abstract_zh: 随着新兴产业的崛起，新职业往往随之涌现。演化经济地理学，特别是产业生命周期理论预测，这些活动最初会在少数城市出现，随后随着职位描述日趋标准化而扩散至其他地区。本文聚焦于一个尤为重要的新兴产业——软件开发：这一经济活动具有重要经济价值、快速迭代特征，且高度集中于少数全球IT枢纽城市。我们利用一个包含超过6000万条软件开发问题与答案的在线数据库，构建了涵盖237项软件技能的纵向数据集。通过对300万用户进行定期地理定位，我们将这些技能与全球城市相关联。研究发现，尽管软件开发具有数字属性，但其空间分布规律与传统行业高度相似：首先，城市会向与其现有技能相关的领域进行多元化拓展；其次，新技能最初出现在软件产业规模庞大且多元化的城市，随后——基本不受地理距离阻碍——向专精于相近技能的小城市扩散。我们发现了支持"区位机会窗口"理论的初步证据，但该理论解释力有限：尽管全新技能仍优先出现在相关技能基础雄厚的城市，但相关活动的集聚程度对新技能涌现的影响，要弱于对现有技能扩散的影响。
title: The Changing Global Division of Labor in Software: Emergence and Diffusion of New Programming Skills across IT Hubs
title_zh: 软件领域全球劳动分工的变迁：新兴编程技能在IT枢纽中的涌现与扩散

abstract: This paper shows that the industrial composition of a city's local economy affects its municipal borrowing costs. In a panel of 1, 177 U.S. cities from 2005 to 2022, greater sectoral concentration magnifies default risk and raises bond spreads, especially for cities dominated by industries associated with low property values. Instrumental variables exploiting national sector-employment trends and regional house-price variation support a causal interpretation. A calibrated model of city default suggests that the observed spread effect understates the gross risk created by concentration, because higher concentration can generate agglomeration benefits that reduce spreads, especially for high-property-value cities.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，城市本地经济的产业结构会影响其市政借款成本。基于2005年至2022年间1,177个美国城市的面板数据，行业集中度越高，违约风险越大，债券利差越高，尤其是在以低房产价值行业为主导的城市中。利用全国行业就业趋势和区域房价变动的工具变量分析支持了因果解释。一个校准的城市违约模型表明，观测到的利差效应低估了集中度产生的总风险，因为更高的集中度可能带来集聚效益，从而降低利差，尤其是在高房产价值城市中。

abstract: We examine how the empirical content of revealed preference theory depends on the dimensionality of the choice environment. While higher-dimensional choice problems may appear more demanding, we show that revealed preference restrictions become less informative. Using Selten's Area measure, we establish that for any fixed number of observations, the empirical content of GARP converges to zero exponentially fast in the number of goods. We provide complementary proofs based on revealed preference graphs and the Afriat inequalities, and show in simulations calibrated to scanner data that the effect is quantitatively large. We also evaluate potential responses in observational and experimental settings and find that, while these can slow the rate, they do not eliminate this loss of empirical content.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了显示偏好理论的经验内容如何依赖于选择环境的维度。尽管高维选择问题看似要求更高，但我们证明显示偏好约束的信息量反而更少。利用塞尔滕面积测度，我们确立：对于任意固定观测次数，GARP的经验内容随商品数量呈指数级收敛至零。我们基于显示偏好图与阿弗里亚特不等式提供了互补性证明，并在基于扫描数据校准的模拟中显示该效应在数量上十分显著。我们还评估了观测与实验情境中的潜在应对措施，发现这些措施虽能减缓收敛速度，但无法消除经验内容的损失。
title: The Empirical Content of Revealed Preference in High Dimensions
title_zh: 高维显示偏好理论的实证内容

abstract: Conventional demographic models systematically overestimate fertility decline in sub-Saharan Africa. This paper proposes a complementary explanation grounded in a prevalent but understudied belief system: ancestors influence the living and seek the continuation of their lineage, into which they may be reincarnated. In this worldview, having children becomes a moral and collective duty, rooted in the spiritual responsibility to ensure the survival of the lineage. Drawing on first-hand data, novel ethnographic information, and historical and contemporary surveys, I document a strong and quantitatively large positive relationship between ancestral beliefs and fertility across contexts and time periods. A simple model in which children are a public good for the lineage rationalizes the patterns observed in the data: the fertility effect of ancestral beliefs is concentrated in patrilineal societies, and a specific form of free-riding emerges among siblings whose children continue the same family line. These findings suggest that high fertility in sub-Saharan Africa rests on moral foundations that standard, externally designed interventions tend to overlook.
abstract_zh: 传统人口模型系统性地高估了撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生育率下降趋势。本文提出一种基于普遍存在但研究不足的信仰体系的补充性解释：祖先能够影响现世生活，并寻求其血脉延续，后代可能成为祖先转世之身。在这种世界观中，生育子女成为植根于精神责任的道德与集体义务，旨在确保家族血脉的存续。通过运用一手数据、新颖的民族志资料以及历史与当代调查，本文证实了祖先信仰与生育率之间在跨时期、跨情境中均存在显著且数量级较大的正向关联。将子女视为家族公共品的简单模型，能够合理解释数据中呈现的规律：祖先信仰对生育率的影响集中于父系社会，且兄弟姐妹间因子女延续同一家族血脉而出现特定形式的搭便车行为。这些发现表明，撒哈拉以南非洲的高生育率建立在被标准外部干预措施所忽视的道德基础之上。
title: Paths to the Rainforests: Ancestral Beliefs and Fertility in Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 通往雨林之路：撒哈拉以南非洲的祖先信仰与生育率

abstract: How does terrorism affect labor markets in developing countries? We combine georeferenced data on terrorist incidents with nationally representative employment data from Nigeria to examine this question. Exploiting within-location variation in exposure to terrorist attacks over time, we show that terrorism reduces employment. A one standard deviation increase in exposure lowers the probability of employment by 0.7 percentage points, or roughly 1 percent of average employment, with substantially larger effects for women. Beyond reducing employment, terrorism shifts workers away from regular and cash-paying jobs and lowers employment in sales, services, and unskilled manual occupations. The findings identify labor market disruption as an important economic cost of insecurity in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 恐怖主义如何影响发展中国家的劳动力市场？我们将恐怖袭击的地理参照数据与尼日利亚具有全国代表性的就业数据相结合来研究这一问题。通过利用同一地区在不同时期遭受恐怖袭击暴露程度的差异，我们发现恐怖主义会降低就业水平。恐怖袭击暴露程度每增加一个标准差，就业概率将下降0.7个百分点（约占平均就业率的1%），且对女性的影响显著更大。除减少就业外，恐怖主义还促使劳动者从正规就业和现金支付岗位转移，并导致销售、服务业及非熟练体力劳动岗位的就业下降。研究结果表明，劳动力市场紊乱是发展中国家不安全局势的重要经济代价。
title: Work Under Attack: Terrorism and Local Labor Markets
title_zh: 遭受攻击下的工作：恐怖主义与地方劳动力市场

abstract: This paper examines whether mobile money reduces gender gaps in financial autonomy across six Sahelian countries using Afrobarometer Round 9 data (2021-2023, N=6, 540). Instrumenting adoption with distance to traditional financial services, we find pronounced heterogeneity: mobile money increases women's autonomy by 11 percentage points in Senegal (26% gap reduction) and 16 points in Sudan (38% reduction), with no detectable effects in four other countries. This variation correlates with ecosystem maturity, agent density, and regulatory quality. Mechanisms include transactional discretion, informal credit access, and enhanced security. Transformative impacts require 10-14 years ecosystem maturation and agent density above 1 per 2, 000 inhabitants. Digital finance advances women's empowerment only under specific institutional conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文利用非洲晴雨表第9轮数据（2021-2023年，样本量N=6,540），考察移动货币是否缩小了萨赫勒地区六国女性金融自主权的性别差距。通过以距离传统金融服务的远近作为移动货币采纳的工具变量，我们发现显著的异质性：移动货币使塞内加尔女性金融自主权提升11个百分点（性别差距缩小26%），苏丹提升16个百分点（性别差距缩小38%），而在其他四个国家未观察到显著影响。这种差异与生态系统成熟度、代理网点密度及监管质量相关。其作用机制包括交易自主权、非正规信贷获取及安全性提升。变革性影响需10-14年生态系统成熟期，且代理网点密度需达到每2000名居民至少1个。数字金融仅在特定制度条件下才能促进女性赋权。
title: Mobile Money and Women's Financial Autonomy in the Sahel: Heterogeneous Effects and Institutional Conditions for Success
title_zh: 萨赫勒地区移动货币与女性金融自主权：异质性效应与成功的制度条件

abstract: We study the evolution of digital and artificial intelligence (AI) skill demand across six economies in Asia and the Pacific between 2019 and 2024 using millions of online job postings from Indeed and a large language model to classify them by their required level of digital and AI proficiency. Digital skill requirements are widespread across the occupational distribution and have expanded most rapidly in traditionally low and mid digital jobs, pointing to broad technological diffusion. Jobs requiring higher digital proficiency command substantially higher pay, even when comparing job postings within the same job title and controlling for cognitive, interpersonal, organizational, and technical skill requirements. We estimate wage premia of approximately 4%, 11%, and 26% for basic, intermediate, and advanced digital skills, respectively, with intermediate and advanced digital skills commanding larger premia than many other highly rewarded skills. We also document a sharp increase in demand for AI-related competencies, particularly those related to the use of AI tools.
abstract_zh: 我们利用Indeed平台数百万条在线招聘信息，结合大语言模型按所需数字与人工智能（AI）技能水平进行分类，研究了2019至2024年间亚太地区六个经济体中数字与AI技能需求的演变。数字技能要求广泛分布于各职业层级，且在传统低数字与中数字岗位中增长最为迅速，这表明技术正在广泛扩散。要求更高数字技能水平的岗位薪资显著更高——即便在相同职位名称内进行比较，并控制认知、人际、组织及技术技能要求后，这一结论依然成立。我们估算出基础、中级与高级数字技能的工资溢价分别约为4%、11%和26%，其中中级与高级数字技能的溢价高于许多其他高回报技能。同时，我们还发现对AI相关能力的需求急剧上升，尤其是涉及AI工具使用的能力。
title: Skills That Pay: Digital Skills Demand and Wage Premia in Asia and the Pacific
title_zh: 技能即报酬：亚太地区的数字技能需求与工资溢价

abstract: This paper examines the employment effects of multinational enterprises (MNEs) in Mexico, focusing on the labor market impacts of foreign tariff increases during 2018-2019. Using data from Mexicos National Survey of Occupations and Employment (ENOE) for 2014-2023 combined with sector-level tariff exposure measures based on Fajgelbaum et al. (2024), we construct a quarterly city-sector panel distinguishing employment in MNEs and domestic firms. We analyze employment outcomes across worker characteristics (education, age, gender) and firm attributes (size and location). Results indicate a positive employment effect in MNEs within the sectors most affected by the tariff increases, particularly for highly educated workers and small establishments. In contrast, there is no clear evidence of significant effects on wages.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了墨西哥跨国企业的就业效应，重点关注2018-2019年外国关税上调对劳动力市场的影响。基于2014-2023年墨西哥国家职业与就业调查（ENOE）数据，结合Fajgelbaum等人（2024）提出的行业层面关税暴露指标，我们构建了区分跨国企业与本土企业就业的季度城市-行业面板数据。通过分析不同劳动者特征（教育程度、年龄、性别）及企业属性（规模与区位）的就业结果，研究发现：在受关税上调影响最严重的行业中，跨国企业呈现正向就业效应，尤其体现在高学历劳动者和小规模企业中。相比之下，工资水平未出现显著变化的明确证据。

abstract: Modeling returns on large portfolios is a challenging problem as the number of parameters in the covariance matrix grows as the square of the size of the portfolio. Traditional correlation models, for example, the dynamic conditional correlation (DCC)-GARCH model, often ignore the nonlinear dependencies in the tail of the return distribution. In this paper, we aim to develop a framework to model the nonlinear dependencies dynamically, namely the graphical copula GARCH (GC-GARCH) model. Motivated from the capital asset pricing model, to allow modeling of large portfolios, the number of parameters can be greatly reduced by introducing conditional independence among stocks given some risk factors. The joint distribution of the risk factors is factorized using a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with pair-copula construction (PCC) to enhance the modeling of the tails of the return distribution while offering the flexibility of having complex dependent structures. The DAG induces topological orders to the risk factors, which can be regarded as a list of directions of the flow of information. The conditional distributions among stock returns are also modeled using PCC. Dynamic conditional dependence structures are incorporated to allow the parameters in the copulas to be time-varying. Three-stage estimation is used to estimate parameters in the marginal distributions, the risk factor copulas, and the stock copulas. The simulation study shows that the proposed estimation procedure can estimate the parameters and the underlying DAG structure accurately. In the investment experiment of the empirical study, we demonstrate that the GC-GARCH model produces more precise conditional value-at-risk prediction and considerably higher cumulative portfolio returns than the DCC-GARCH model.
title: Graphical Copula GARCH Modeling with Dynamic Conditional Dependence

abstract: Public procurement of innovation (PPI) is widely regarded as a powerful demand-side policy instrument to stimulate innovation, but its role in shaping regional technological diversification remains unclear. Drawing on evolutionary economic geography, this study examines how PPI affects technological diversification under different spatial sourcing strategies. Using 2.24 million procurement contracts and 2.41 million patents from China (2016-2021), we find that PPI facilitates path-breaking diversification, but mainly through non-local procurement. Compared with local procurement, non-local procurement is more conducive to path-breaking diversification in purchasing regions, while its benefits do not spill over symmetrically to supplying regions. By reconceptualizing PPI as a spatially embedded and relational mechanism, this study extends evolutionary accounts of regional diversification beyond a purely territorial lens and highlights how the spatial organization of public demand shapes uneven opportunities for regional technological development.

abstract: Studies about climate change effects on service industries in developing countries are limited. Using data from daily flights among 211 Chinese airports (2015–2017), this paper investigates the causal impacts of extreme temperatures on aviation service quality, measured by flight delays. We find that extreme low temperatures significantly increase flight delays, with additional exposure causing longer departure delays, arrival delays, and excessive travel time. Conversely, extreme high temperatures have limited effects or even improve punctuality. This discrepancy arises primarily from differing meteorological disruptions and distinct market-driven airline operational adjustments in response to cold versus hot weather conditions. Low temperatures ( 20 °C) yields average monetary gains equivalent to about 0.04% of local GDP.

abstract: In many parts of Europe, particularly in countries such as Spain, Poland, Italy, Portugal, and Romania, farmland abandonment is widespread as a result of changing land use and socioeconomic circumstances. A balanced strategy is needed to identify which abandoned lands should be restored for agricultural production and which should remain unused. Although earlier research has shown that land consolidation can lower the likelihood of abandonment, no studies have used local-scale data and high-resolution spatial datasets to determine whether abandoned land can be returned to production. In this study, a new approach is proposed for the regeneration of abandoned agricultural lands through land consolidation. In order to find abandoned agricultural parcels that could be restored by land consolidation, this study presents a novel methodology that combines cadastral databases with data from Airborne Laser Scanning (ALS). The study was conducted in Małopolskie Voivodeship, southern Poland, with a detailed case study in Olkusz Poviat, where agricultural land abandonment is relatively high. A total of 79 villages with a combined area of 620 km² were selected as the study area. The villages are prioritized for land consolidation projects based on their potential, with a unique reward-penalty function applied based on vegetation height, prioritizing areas with the highest likelihood of reducing or reversing land abandonment. The proposed approach identifies which abandoned lands can be returned to production as part of land consolidation efforts. This study presents a new, data-driven approach to rural land management that enables targeted policy interventions, allowing planners to prioritize areas at high risk of abandonment, make informed decisions, and develop land consolidation projects that maximize sustainable land use and agricultural productivity.

abstract: China's accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 reshaped global trade, reducing U.S. demand for Mexican manufactured goods and weakening Mexico's manufacturing employment. This study estimates how this trade‐induced decline affected migration and employment decisions among rural Mexicans. Using individual‐level panel data from the Mexican National Rural Household Survey (ENHRUM) and a long‐difference framework, we instrument manufacturing employment with regional exposure to Chinese import competition. Results show that a 10‐percentage‐point decline in manufacturing employment increased the probability of U.S. migration by 24 percentage points and U.S. nonagricultural employment by 17 points, with no significant effects on agricultural employment.
abstract_zh: 2001年中国加入世界贸易组织重塑了全球贸易格局，导致美国对墨西哥制成品的需求下降，进而削弱了墨西哥制造业的就业水平。本研究旨在估算这一贸易冲击引发的制造业就业萎缩对墨西哥农村人口迁移及就业决策的影响。基于墨西哥国家农村家庭调查（ENHRUM）的个体层面面板数据，采用长期差分框架，以各地区对中国进口竞争的暴露度作为制造业就业的工具变量。结果表明：制造业就业率每下降10个百分点，农村人口迁移至美国的概率增加24个百分点，在美国从事非农就业的概率上升17个百分点，而对农业就业未产生显著影响。

abstract: This paper investigates how lenders' costs of funds affect agricultural loan interest rates. We use a matched sample of US farm‐loan data and lender‐specific cost of funds, and a farm fixed effects design, to estimate pass‐through, conditioning on borrower characteristics. We find modest average pass‐through of funding costs to farm loan interest rates, with meaningful differences across lender types and local market conditions. Our findings suggest that borrower characteristics and common macroeconomic trends remain central to agricultural loan pricing, but lender business models and local credit market structure also shape how changes in funding costs affect farm borrowing costs.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了贷款机构的资金成本如何影响农业贷款利率。我们利用美国农场贷款数据与贷款机构特定资金成本的匹配样本，并采用农场固定效应模型，在控制借款人特征的情况下估计传导效应。研究发现，资金成本向农场贷款利率的平均传导程度较为温和，且在不同贷款机构类型和当地市场条件下存在显著差异。我们的结果表明，借款人特征和共同宏观经济趋势仍是农业贷款定价的核心因素，但贷款机构的商业模式和当地信贷市场结构同样影响着资金成本变化对农场借贷成本的作用路径。
title: How Lender Cost of Funds and Market Structure Shape Agricultural Interest Rates
title_zh: 贷款资金成本与市场结构如何塑造农业贷款利率

abstract: This study investigates the impact of central bank transparency (CBT) on foreign exchange market vulnerability, measured by exchange market pressure (EMP). Using panel autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) analysis on a sample of 32 countries, the results show that greater CBT significantly reduces EMP. The findings remain robust after controlling for U.S. monetary policy uncertainty, economic policy uncertainty, and financial development. However, no evidence is found that CBT becomes more effective during periods of heightened uncertainty. Further analysis indicates that exchange rate flexibility and financial integration strengthen the mitigating effect of CBT on EMP in emerging markets but not in developed markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中央银行透明度（CBT）对外汇市场脆弱性（以汇率市场压力（EMP）衡量）的影响。通过对32个国家的面板自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型分析，结果表明，更高的中央银行透明度显著降低了汇率市场压力。在控制美国货币政策不确定性、经济政策不确定性和金融发展水平后，该结论依然稳健。然而，未发现中央银行透明度在不确定性加剧时期更为有效的证据。进一步分析表明，汇率灵活性和金融一体化增强了中央银行透明度对新兴市场汇率市场压力的缓解效应，但在发达市场中并不显著。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Does Central Bank Transparency Curb Foreign Exchange Vulnerability?
title_zh: 中央银行透明度能否抑制外汇脆弱性？

abstract: We develop a tractable general equilibrium model of cumulative innovation and growth to study the optimal combinations of three patent instruments: a patentability requirement to protect against future incremental innovation, a patent breadth to protect against current imitation, and the patent length governing the duration of its validity. New ideas strictly build upon frontier technologies, with the size of productivity improvements drawn from a stochastic distribution. The model features positive knowledge spillovers, and we discuss when this leads to under-investment in R&D in the market equilibrium relative to the social planner’s benchmark. We characterize analytically how each patent instrument affects research incentives, and further establish that the patentability requirement and patent breadth in the welfare-maximizing combination are each set at a strictly lower level than in the R&D-maximizing combination. Calibrating the model to aggregate data, the welfare-maximizing combination of instruments features a large patent breadth, a long patent duration, but a modest patentability requirement. The quantitative analysis points to sizeable welfare gains from these patent policies, while highlighting the importance of having multiple patent instruments.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个易于处理的累积创新与增长一般均衡模型，旨在研究三种专利工具的最优组合：保护未来增量创新的可专利性要求、保护当前模仿的专利宽度，以及决定其有效期限的专利长度。新思想严格建立在尖端技术之上，生产力改进的规模从随机分布中抽取。模型包含正向知识溢出效应，我们讨论了在何种情况下，这会导致市场均衡中的研发投资相对于社会规划者基准而言不足。我们分析性地刻画了每种专利工具如何影响研究激励，并进一步确立，在福利最大化组合中，可专利性要求和专利宽度均严格低于研发最大化组合中的水平。将模型校准至总体数据后，福利最大化的工具组合表现为较大的专利宽度、较长的专利期限，但适度的可专利性要求。定量分析指出这些专利政策能带来显著的福利收益，同时强调了拥有多种专利工具的重要性。
title: Optimal Combination of Patent Instruments in a Cumulative-Innovation Growth Model
title_zh: 累积创新增长模型中专利工具的最优组合

abstract: Using newly collected discount rate data for six Swiss cities from 1846 to 1893, we find no evidence of increasing integration during a 30‐year period of lightly regulated free banking. We attribute this to two structural issues: banks had incentives to ward off competitors by protecting their local monopolies or forming cartels, and there was always a risk (which varied across banks) that banknotes were not accepted or converted at par. We use a novel counterfactual to show that these issues increased discount rate dispersion, and argue that as a result, public regulation of payments infrastructure was necessary for money market integration.
abstract_zh: 利用1846至1893年间瑞士六座城市新收集的贴现率数据，我们发现在30年轻度监管的自由银行时期，市场一体化程度并未增强。我们将此归因于两个结构性问题：银行有动机通过保护本地垄断或组建卡特尔来抵御竞争对手，且始终存在银行券不被按面值接受或兑换的风险（该风险因银行而异）。我们采用新颖的反事实分析方法表明，这些问题加剧了贴现率离散程度，并据此论证：支付基础设施的公共监管对于货币市场一体化具有必要性。
title: Private money and money market integration: The role of payments infrastructure in nineteenth‐century Switzerland
title_zh: 私人货币与货币市场一体化：19世纪瑞士支付基础设施的作用

abstract: Online auctions have declined in popularity, often due to their high transaction costs. This paper focuses on one such cost: the hassle cost of bidding in often prolonged online auctions. We develop a structural model of ascending auctions with costly bidding that resembles a war of attrition. We show that even in private value settings, bidders strategically lower their bids to avoid hassle. Using data from a large online auto auction platform, we estimate that the average winner incurs hassle costs equivalent to 1.7% of the vehicle’s sale price, while sellers lose 5.0% in revenue due to bid-shading. Counterfactual simulations suggest that higher reserve prices can limit unproductive bidding and partially offset the loss.
abstract_zh: 在线拍卖的受欢迎程度有所下降，这往往归因于其高昂的交易成本。本文聚焦于其中一种成本：在通常漫长的在线拍卖中出价所带来的麻烦成本。我们构建了一个带有昂贵出价的结构性升价拍卖模型，该模型类似于消耗战。我们证明，即使在私有价值情境下，竞标者也会策略性地降低出价以避免麻烦。利用一个大型在线汽车拍卖平台的数据，我们估计平均获胜者承担的麻烦成本相当于车辆售价的1.7%，而卖家因出价缩减损失了5.0%的收入。反事实模拟表明，更高的保留价可以限制非生产性出价，并部分抵消这一损失。
title: Hassle Costs in Online Auctions
title_zh: 在线拍卖中的麻烦成本

abstract: In this paper, we investigate changes in time allocated to routine housework around four life events – cohabitation, marriage, first birth, and divorce – to explore the influence of social norms on gendered housework patterns. Using data from the German Socio‐Economic Panel (1991–2019), a timing‐based event study design reveals that gender differences intensify with cohabitation and parenthood. Women's housework hours increase significantly with the first child, while men's decrease. Marriage has no additional impact beyond cohabitation, and divorce leads to a rise in men's and a reduction in women's housework. Couples with higher‐earning women and those in East Germany show weaker adherence to these social roles.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察同居、结婚、生育第一个子女和离婚四个人生事件前后日常家务劳动时间的变化，探究社会规范对性别化家务分工模式的影响。基于德国社会经济面板数据（1991-2019年）的时间事件研究设计显示，性别差异在同居和成为父母后加剧。女性家务劳动时间在生育第一个子女后显著增加，而男性则减少。婚姻对家务时间的影响未超出同居效应，离婚则导致男性家务时间上升、女性家务时间下降。女性收入较高的夫妻以及东德地区的夫妻，对社会角色的遵循程度较弱。
title: Uncovering the choreography of life: the impact of life transitions on gendered housework patterns
title_zh: 揭示生活编排：生命转折对性别化家务模式的影响

abstract: This paper investigates how supply disruptions and economic slack affect the responsiveness of inflation to changes in aggregate demand. We propose and estimate a nonlinear Phillips curve, whereby the sensitivity of inflation to changes in demand varies with supply conditions and the amount of slack in the economy. We find evidence that supply disruptions and low unemployment both steepen the Phillips curve, thereby amplifying the inflationary effects of increased demand. Our results suggest that the effects of fiscal policy on inflation depend on the prevailing supply conditions and the level of unemployment in the economy.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了供给中断与经济松弛如何影响通胀对总需求变化的响应程度。我们提出并估计了一个非线性菲利普斯曲线，其中通胀对需求变化的敏感度随供给状况和经济中的松弛程度而变化。研究发现，供给中断和低失业率均会使菲利普斯曲线陡峭化，从而放大需求增加带来的通胀效应。结果表明，财政政策对通胀的影响取决于经济中当前的供给状况和失业水平。
title: Supply disruptions, economic slack, and the state‐dependent Phillips curve
title_zh: 供应中断、经济疲软与状态依赖型菲利普斯曲线

abstract: The super manager model developed in Baranchuk et al. (2011) is revisited in this paper. We show that an important condition required for the firm’s optimization problem was overlooked. Once this condition is imposed, the market equilibrium derived in the original paper may fail to exist for certain parameter values. In particular, the existence of interior hierarchical equilibrium is conditional on managerial productivity exceeding organizational costs, and disappears when demand is sufficiently weak, in the sense that no admissible interior super-manager equilibrium exists We derive the corrected equilibrium system and provide numerical illustrations showing that sufficiently weak demand can eliminate any admissible interior super-manager equilibrium. Our results not only clarify the conditions under which the equilibrium of the super manager model is well defined, but also provide economic interpretations when no admissible interior super-manager equilibrium exists.
abstract_zh: 本文重新审视了Baranchuk等人（2011）提出的超级管理者模型。我们发现，该模型在企业优化问题中所需的一个重要条件被忽视了。一旦施加此条件，原论文中推导出的市场均衡在特定参数值下可能不存在。特别是，内部层级均衡的存在性取决于管理生产率是否超过组织成本，并且当需求足够疲弱时，该均衡会消失，即不存在任何可容许的内部超级管理者均衡。我们推导了修正后的均衡体系，并通过数值示例说明，需求不足够强时，任何可容许的内部超级管理者均衡都可能被消除。我们的结果不仅澄清了超级管理者模型均衡定义明确的条件，还为不存在可容许的内部超级管理者均衡时提供了经济学解释。
title: On the existence of equilibrium in the super manager model
title_zh: 超级经理人模型中均衡的存在性

abstract: I study a risk-neutral principal–agent model with moral hazard, limited liability, and renegotiation. With common beliefs, renegotiation is irrelevant under risk neutrality. With heterogeneous beliefs, renegotiation reshapes the contract into a pure “side bet”: after the action is sunk, the principal concentrates all promised compensation on the outcome the agent overweights the most, which can raise compensation costs and even make some actions non-implementable. Under the monotone-likelihood-ratio property and optimism (likelihood-ratio dominance), the disagreement-maximizing outcome coincides with the incentive-efficient outcome, so renegotiation is again innocuous.
abstract_zh: 我研究了一个风险中性的委托-代理模型，该模型包含道德风险、有限责任和再谈判。在共同信念下，风险中性时再谈判无关紧要。在异质信念下，再谈判将合同重塑为纯粹的“对赌”：在行动沉没后，委托人将所有承诺的补偿集中于代理人过度加权最多的结果上，这可能提高补偿成本，甚至使某些行动无法实施。在单调似然比性质和乐观主义（似然比支配）下，分歧最大化的结果与激励有效的结果一致，因此再谈判再次变得无害。
title: Renegotiation and heterogeneous beliefs with risk neutrality
title_zh: 风险中性下的重新谈判与异质信念

abstract: Each agent in our model occupies a position in a hierarchy (a directed tree) and generates returns through collaborating with his superiors. Thus his superiors can also claim their ownership rights over his returns. Our main axiom for the allocation of these returns is the standard monotonicity with regard to the collective ownership. We establish axiomatic characterizations of monotonic allocation rules. They are represented by hierarchical transfers of the returns at each position to the superiors. When the rate of transfer is symmetric, the rules coincide with the geometric rules (ownership rates constitute a geometric sequence, moving up the hierarchy). Other fair allocation rules are also available, when the rate of transfer is asymmetric; a focal example is the hierarchical equal sharing rule, which is shown to be the unique one with an equal treatment axiom.
abstract_zh: 在我们的模型中，每个代理在层级结构（一个有向树）中占据一个位置，并通过与上级合作产生收益。因此，他的上级也可以对其收益主张所有权。我们分配这些收益的主要公理是关于集体所有权的标准单调性。我们建立了单调分配规则的公理化特征描述。这些规则通过层级中每个位置向上级的收益转移来表示。当转移率对称时，这些规则与几何规则一致（所有权比率构成一个几何序列，沿层级向上移动）。当转移率不对称时，其他公平分配规则也可用；一个典型的例子是层级平等分享规则，该规则被证明是唯一满足平等对待公理的规则。
title: Fair Allocation in Hierarchies
title_zh: 层级中的公平分配

abstract: We study optimal mechanisms for a data broker selling market segmentation to a producer. The producer engages in discriminatory pricing and is privately informed about a payoff-relevant parameter. We first characterize a class of markets from which the segmentations in optimal mechanisms can be constructed. If the profit-maximizing prices of different producer types are ordered and only downward or only upward incentive constraints bind, this analysis shows that in any created market either all consumer types are served or just a single one. We then characterize optimal mechanisms for a valuation structure that captures differing product quality. In particular, the consumers are segmented into markets in which everyone is served. Lastly, we give a sufficient condition under which optimal mechanisms are efficient regardless of the binding constraints.
abstract_zh: 我们研究数据经纪人向生产者出售市场细分的最优机制。生产者实行歧视性定价，并私下知晓一个影响收益的参数。我们首先刻画了一类市场，从中可以构建最优机制中的细分。若不同生产者类型的利润最大化价格有序排列，且仅向下或仅向上的激励约束起作用，此分析表明，在任何创建的市场中，要么所有消费者类型都被服务，要么仅有一个被服务。随后，我们针对一种体现产品质量差异的估值结构，刻画了最优机制。特别是，消费者被细分为所有个体均被服务的市场。最后，我们给出一个充分条件，在此条件下，无论约束如何绑定，最优机制都是有效的。
title: Optimal Mechanisms for Selling Market Segmentation
title_zh: 市场细分的最优销售机制

abstract: We study how financial shocks affect the income distribution in the euro area. Using survey-based microdata from 16 countries and a functional pooled panel VAR, we trace impulse responses of the full income distribution. Positive financial shocks increase gross market income inequality: upper-tail incomes rise persistently, whereas lower-tail incomes weaken on impact and recover gradually, even as the mass at zero income declines. Decomposing income into property and labor components reveals two transmission channels. Property income responds quickly, consistent with asset-price revaluation and concentrated financial asset holdings. Labor income responds more gradually and persistently, consistent with broader labor-market adjustment in margins and composition. We also document asymmetries: financial expansions raise inequality, whereas financial contractions initially compress top incomes. The asymmetry is strongest for financial asset income.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了金融冲击如何影响欧元区的收入分配。利用来自16个国家的基于调查的微观数据以及功能性面板VAR模型，我们追踪了完整收入分布的脉冲响应。正向金融冲击加剧了总市场收入不平等：高收入端收入持续上升，而低收入端收入在冲击初期减弱并逐步恢复，即便零收入群体的比例有所下降。将收入分解为财产性收入和劳动收入后，揭示了两种传导渠道。财产性收入反应迅速，与资产价格重估及金融资产持有集中度一致。劳动收入反应则更为渐进且持久，与劳动力市场在边际和构成上的广泛调整相符。我们还记录了不对称性：金融扩张加剧不平等，而金融收缩初期压缩高收入端收入。这种不对称性在金融资产收入中表现最为显著。
title: Disentangling the distributional effects of financial shocks in the euro area
title_zh: 欧元区金融冲击的分配效应解析

abstract: This paper examines the causal effects of a school feeding program on maternal empowerment and household consumption in rural China. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Student Nutrition Improvement Program, we find that the program significantly reduces maternal time spent on housework, improves maternal labor market performance, and enhances maternal decision‐making power within nuclear households. The augmented bargaining power translates into shifts in household consumption toward female‐prioritized goods, including more nutritious foods, clothing, and housework‐related appliances. However, these positive effects on maternal empowerment are diminished in multigenerational families, where grandparents can assist with childcare responsibilities.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了学校供餐计划对中国农村地区女性赋权及家庭消费的因果效应。利用学生营养改善计划的分阶段实施，我们发现该计划显著减少了母亲的家务劳动时间，改善了母亲在劳动力市场的表现，并增强了母亲在核心家庭中的决策权。这种议价能力的提升促使家庭消费转向女性优先商品，包括更营养的食品、衣物及家务相关电器。然而，在多代同堂的家庭中，由于祖父母可协助承担育儿责任，这些对女性赋权的积极影响有所减弱。

abstract: This paper rationalizes the adoption of a complementary currency (CC) in a small, local economy. A local money shortage occurs when the supply of official currency, determined endogenously by trade with a larger economy, falls short of the liquidity needed for first‐best activity. A CC then supplements liquidity and boosts local trade at the expense of external trade; the welfare‐maximizing CC supply is strictly positive. A calibration to coca‐growing villages in Colombia, where coca‐base circulates as a local CC, suggests its liquidity role raises local trade by roughly a third.
abstract_zh: 本文对小型地方经济中采用补充货币（CC）的行为进行了理性阐释。当由与较大经济体贸易内生决定的官方货币供给，不足以支撑最优经济活动所需的流动性时，便会出现地方性货币短缺。此时，补充货币可补充流动性，并在减少外部贸易的同时促进地方贸易；福利最大化的补充货币供给严格为正。通过对哥伦比亚古柯种植村庄（当地以古柯碱作为补充货币流通）进行校准分析，结果表明其流动性作用使地方贸易额提升了约三分之一。
title: Money Shortages and Complementary Currencies in Small Local Economies
title_zh: 小型地方经济中的货币短缺与互补货币

abstract: Amid the imperative for global climate governance and sustainable development, green technological innovation is a vital path for firms to overcome resource constraints and improve development quality. By bridging firms and capital markets, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) ratings improve the external information environment and establish a market-based governance framework aligned with green innovation incentives. Leveraging SynTao Green Finance’s inaugural publication of ESG ratings as a quasi-natural experiment, this article examines the effect of these ratings on green technological innovation, using a time-varying difference-in-differences approach on Chinese A-share listed firms from 2009 to 2021. We find that favourable ESG performance significantly promotes green technological innovation, a result confirmed by extensive robustness checks. Three transmission channels are identified: alleviating financing constraints, raising innovation efficiency, and amplifying market attention. The promotional effect is particularly salient in growth-stage, eastern-region, high-tech, and highly competitive firms. Further analysis shows that ESG ratings strengthen the intertemporal continuity of corporate green innovation and that CEOs’ green professional background positively moderates this relationship. Regulators should accelerate the standardization of China’s ESG disclosure framework and broaden its coverage. Firms should strengthen internal controls and non-financial reporting so that improved ESG performance translates into substantive green innovation.
abstract_zh: 在全球气候治理与可持续发展的紧迫要求下，绿色技术创新成为企业突破资源约束、提升发展质量的关键路径。环境、社会和治理（ESG）评级通过连接企业与资本市场，改善了外部信息环境，并构建了与绿色创新激励相容的市场化治理机制。本文以商道融绿首次发布ESG评级作为准自然实验，采用时变双重差分法，基于2009—2021年中国A股上市公司数据，考察ESG评级对绿色技术创新的影响。研究发现，良好的ESG表现显著促进了企业绿色技术创新，该结论经过一系列稳健性检验后依然成立。机制分析表明，缓解融资约束、提升创新效率以及增强市场关注是三条传导渠道。异质性分析显示，这一促进效应在成长期企业、东部地区企业、高技术企业以及高竞争行业企业中更为显著。进一步分析表明，ESG评级增强了企业绿色创新的跨期连续性，且CEO的绿色职业背景对这一关系具有正向调节作用。监管机构应加快中国ESG披露框架的标准化进程并扩大覆盖范围；企业应强化内部控制与非财务信息披露，使ESG表现的改善切实转化为实质性绿色创新。

title: Does ESG performance drive enterprise green technological innovation? Evidence from China

abstract: Previous studies have shown that aggregate shocks shape households’ financial conditions and influence their investment behaviour. However, literature provides mixed evidence on the persistence of household investment behaviour in the aftermath of such shocks. This study utilizes a large panel household dataset from India to analyse the investment choices of households in the aftermath of a nationwide pandemic. Our findings indicate that households that experienced adverse impacts on their financial conditions during the crisis have a 2.2% points higher likelihood of investing in relatively safe assets compared to other households. Importantly, a similar preference for safer assets persists in the post-crisis period for such households. This persistence is primarily driven by households whose financial conditions did not improve in the post-crisis period. We also find that financially-strained households’ preference for safer assets is lower in regions that are better banked. Our baseline results are robust to alternate definitions of safe and risky assets, crisis intensity, financially-strained households, potential selection bias, and placebo tests. Our findings suggest that alleviating financial strain and enhancing access to banking services can mitigate risk-averse behaviour both during a crisis and in the subsequent period.
abstract_zh: 已有研究表明，总体冲击会塑造家庭的财务状况并影响其投资行为。然而，关于此类冲击后家庭投资行为持续性的文献证据并不一致。本研究利用印度大规模家庭面板数据，分析全国性疫情后家庭的投资选择。研究结果显示，在危机期间财务状况受到不利影响的家庭，相较于其他家庭，投资相对安全资产的可能性高出2.2个百分点。重要的是，此类家庭在危机后时期仍持续表现出对安全资产的类似偏好。这种持续性主要由危机后财务状况未改善的家庭驱动。我们还发现，在银行服务更完善的地区，财务紧张家庭对安全资产的偏好较低。我们的基准结果在安全与风险资产的不同定义、危机强度、财务紧张家庭界定、潜在选择偏差及安慰剂检验中均保持稳健。研究结论表明，缓解财务压力并增强银行服务可及性，有助于在危机期间及后续时期降低风险规避行为。
title: Financial asset choices in the aftermath of a crisis: evidence from India
title_zh: 危机后金融资产选择：来自印度的证据

abstract: This article examines whether Latin American countries are keeping pace with global trends in trade agreement depth or falling behind. Using 681 agreements (1970–2019), we develop the Depth Index of Trade Agreements (DITA) to weight provisions endogenously through factor analysis based on co‐occurrence patterns. Results show that the Pacific Alliance and Central America lag one decade behind North American standards, whereas South America and the Caribbean lag by two to three decades. Partner selection is critical: countries negotiating extensively with developed partners tend to incorporate similar provisions into South–South agreements, suggesting North–South spillover effects. These findings suggest that regional lag reflects policy choices rather than inherent constraints.
abstract_zh: 本文考察拉丁美洲国家在全球贸易协定深度趋势中是同步跟进还是落后。基于681项协定（1970-2019年），我们通过因子分析依据条款共现模式内生性加权，构建了贸易协定深度指数（DITA）。结果显示，太平洋联盟和中美洲落后于北美标准约十年，而南美洲和加勒比地区则落后二至三十年。合作伙伴选择至关重要：与发达国家进行广泛谈判的国家，倾向于将类似条款纳入南南协定中，这表明存在南北溢出效应。这些发现表明，区域滞后反映的是政策选择而非固有约束。
title: Keeping Pace or Falling Behind? The Depth of Latin American Trade Agreements
title_zh: 保持同步还是落后？拉丁美洲贸易协定的深度

abstract: We introduce general estimation and inference methods for threshold spatial panel regression with two-way fixed effects in a diminishing-threshold-effects framework. A valid objective function is obtained through a simple adjustment on the concentrated quasi loglikelihood with fixed effects being concentrated out, which leads to a consistent estimation of all common parameters. We show that the estimation of threshold parameter has a negligible effect on the asymptotic distribution of the main parameter estimators and thereby regular inference methods apply, though a bias correction may be necessary. The limiting distribution of the threshold parameter estimator is shown to be non-regular and infeasible, and for inference, a likelihood ratio test procedure is proposed. The test for the non-existence of threshold effects faces an identification issue at the null. To overcome this difficulty, we propose a sup-Wald test and a bootstrap method for its critical values. Monte Carlo results show that the proposed methods perform well in finite samples. An empirical application is presented on age-of-leader effects on political competitions across Chinese cities.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在阈值效应递减框架下，针对具有双向固定效应的阈值空间面板回归的通用估计与推断方法。通过简单调整集中拟对数似然函数，并消去固定效应，我们获得了一个有效的目标函数，从而实现对所有共同参数的一致估计。研究表明，阈值参数的估计对主要参数估计量的渐近分布影响可忽略不计，因此常规推断方法适用，尽管可能需要进行偏差校正。阈值参数估计量的极限分布被证明是非正则且不可行的，为此，我们提出了一种似然比检验程序进行推断。对于阈值效应不存在性的检验，在零假设下存在识别问题。为克服这一困难，我们提出了一个sup-Wald检验及其临界值的自助法。蒙特卡洛结果表明，所提方法在有限样本中表现良好。我们还提供了一个实证应用，研究中国各城市政治竞争中领导人年龄效应的影响。
